cases.name: computed-member-access
cases.description: Subscripting in an if expression, which the evaluator does not implement

cases.name: repeat-on-a-counter
cases.description: A counter's value follows the row index, and a list of unknown length leaves no index to follow. The message names the type.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="X"><gen type="increment" value="1" repeat="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: gen-count-is-not-a-gen-attribute
cases.description: count= is the run on <env> and the table on <pool>; a <gen> reads neither, and the value looks like a way to ask for several values
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b" count="99"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: gen-flag-belongs-to-mix
cases.description: flag= records which branch a <mix> took; the <gen> equivalent is anomaly_flag=
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b" flag="X"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: cycle-without-a-walk
cases.description: cycle= says what happens when a walk runs out — without order="sequential" the generator draws, and a draw never runs out
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b" cycle="false"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: order-on-a-template-generator
cases.description: A pack's parameters are open-ended, but which type reads order= does not depend on the pack
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="template" value="person.lastName" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: parent-on-a-template-generator
cases.description: parent= filters a whole <sequence>; on a <gen> it was accepted and read by nobody
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="template" value="person.lastName" parent="X.y"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: local-on-a-generator-is-real
cases.description: local= on a <gen> DOES override the locale for that generator — the sweep called it a no-op and measuring said otherwise
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="template" value="person.lastName" local="ru"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: interpolation-in-an-attribute-that-does-not-expand-it
cases.description: Interpolation reaches the text inside <data> and <gen type="template" value=>, and nowhere else. Written anywhere else the braces are literal characters, and the generator that receives them used to complain about whatever it happened to be parsing: an invalid number range here, an invalid date on a date, a bad quantifier on a regex, an unknown alphabet on a symbol — and type="text" said nothing at all and emitted the braces. One cause, six answers, none of them naming it. TDC263 names it, and REPLACES the generator's own complaint rather than sitting beside it.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="text" value="5"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="1..${{N}}"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: interpolation-in-a-date-bound
cases.description: The same mistake one generator across: from= reads a date, not a column. The reader has seen ${{}} work in a template value and moved it, which is the most natural thing in the world.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="text" value="5"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="date" from="${{N}}" to="2026-12-31"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>
